newsHighlights.title: Travel, consumption spending vibrant during holiday
newsHighlights.summary: Holiday travel and consumption spending stayed vibrant across China, as millions of people visited scenic spots, museums and hometowns.
newsHighlights.translation: 节日期间，中国各地旅游与消费支出保持旺盛，数以百万计的游客走进景区、博物馆与家乡。

newsHighlights.title: 10 things in China that blow foreign visitors' minds
newsHighlights.summary: From high-speed rail to late-night street food, foreign visitors share the details of Chinese life that surprise and delight them most.
newsHighlights.translation: 从高铁到深夜街头小吃，外国游客分享了中国生活中最让他们惊喜的细节。

newsHighlights.title: Flame lit in Turin for Changchun 2027 Winter Universiade
newsHighlights.summary: The flame for the Changchun 2027 Winter Universiade was lit in Turin, Italy, kicking off the countdown to the global student sports festival.
newsHighlights.translation: 2027年长春冬季大运会火种在意大利都灵点燃，全球学生体育盛会进入倒计时。

newsHighlights.title: Gen Z finds a sweet future in hometown's green transition
newsHighlights.summary: In Jiangxi's Tianhe town, young people turned a former coal-mining area into a beekeeping and eco-tourism destination.
newsHighlights.translation: 在江西天河镇，年轻人把昔日的煤矿小镇转型为养蜂与生态旅游目的地。

newsHighlights.title: Autumn grain harvest in full swing across China
newsHighlights.summary: The autumn grain harvest is in full swing nationwide, offering rural landscapes that draw city travelers seeking countryside experiences.
newsHighlights.translation: 全国各地秋粮收获正全面展开，乡村田园风光吸引着寻求乡野体验的城市游客。

quote.quote: The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only one page.
quote.author: Saint Augustine
quote.translation: 世界是一本书，不旅行的人只读了其中一页。
quote.explanation: 旅行让我们接触不同的文化、风景与生活方式，拓宽视野。正如今日新闻所展示的，无论是外国游客眼中的中国，还是中国游客的假日出行，每一次旅途都是翻阅世界这本大书的新一页。

vocabulary.definition: 生机勃勃的；充满活力的
vocabulary.example: Travel and consumption spending remained vibrant during the holiday.
vocabulary.translation: 节日期间，旅游与消费支出保持旺盛。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题 Travel, consumption spending vibrant during holiday，形容假日经济充满活力。

vocabulary.example: Holiday consumption reached new highs in restaurants, hotels and shopping malls.
vocabulary.translation: 假日消费在餐饮、酒店和商场创下新高。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 Travel, consumption spending vibrant during holiday，指居民节日期间的消费支出。

vocabulary.example: The mountain town has become a popular destination for young travelers.
vocabulary.translation: 这座山区小镇已成为年轻游客喜爱的目的地。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 Gen Z finds a sweet future in hometown's green transition，天河镇转型为生态旅游目的地（eco-tourism destination）。

vocabulary.example: Foreign visitors often praise the warmth and hospitality of Chinese hosts.
vocabulary.translation: 外国游客常常称赞中国东道主的热情与好客。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 10 things in China that blow foreign visitors' minds，中国人的待客之道令外国游客印象深刻。

vocabulary.example: The terraced fields offered spectacular views during the autumn harvest.
vocabulary.translation: 秋收时节，梯田呈现出壮观的景色。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 Autumn grain harvest in full swing across China，秋收田园风光美不胜收。

vocabulary.definition: 遗产（尤指文化遗产、传统）
vocabulary.example: Visitors can explore both natural scenery and cultural heritage in the same trip.
vocabulary.translation: 游客可以在同一次旅行中既欣赏自然风光，又探访文化遗产。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 10 things in China that blow foreign visitors' minds，中国的文化遗产是令外国游客惊叹的重点之一。

vocabulary.example: The torch relay will carry the flame from Turin to Changchun.
vocabulary.translation: 火炬接力将把火种从都灵传递到长春。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 Flame lit in Turin for Changchun 2027 Winter Universiade，大运会火炬与火种相关。

vocabulary.example: The town's green transition brought new jobs in tourism and beekeeping.
vocabulary.translation: 小镇的绿色转型带来了旅游与养蜂领域的新岗位。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 Gen Z finds a sweet future in hometown's green transition，指煤矿小镇向绿色经济的转型。

vocabulary.example: Farmers are busy harvesting autumn grain across the country.
vocabulary.translation: 全国各地的农民正忙于收割秋粮。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 Autumn grain harvest in full swing across China，描述秋粮收获全面展开。

vocabulary.definition: 标志性的；具有代表性的
vocabulary.example: High-speed rail has become an iconic part of travel in China.
vocabulary.translation: 高铁已成为中国旅行的标志性元素。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 10 things in China that blow foreign visitors' minds，高铁等标志性事物令外国游客赞叹。

pattern.pattern: so + 形容词/副词 + that + 从句（如此……以至于……）
pattern.example: The holiday travel rush was so intense that many scenic spots reported record visitor numbers.
pattern.translation: 假日出行热潮如此汹涌，以至于许多景区的游客接待量创下纪录。
pattern.usage: 用 so...that... 表示程度之深导致某种结果。注意 so 后接形容词或副词，that 后接完整的结果状语从句。写作中可用于描述旅行体验：The view was so breathtaking that we forgot to take photos.

grammar.title: 限制性定语从句（that / which / who）
grammar.explanation: 当先行词指物时，用 that 或 which 引导定语从句并作主语或宾语；指人时用 who。从句对先行词起限定作用，去掉后句意不完整。在标题英语中常省略宾语位置的关系代词或直接用 that 引导，简洁有力。
examples: 10 things in China that blow foreign visitors' minds.
A super El Nino event that formed in September is expected to become the strongest on record.

pronunciation.tips: 注意重音在第三个音节 /tæ/，前面的 hos- 读作 /ˌhɒspɪ/，轻而快；-tality 读作 /ˈtæləti/，第二个 t 在美音中可浊化为闪音。切勿读成 hos-pi-TAL-i-ty 时把重音放错位置。
examples: Chinese hospitality leaves a deep impression on foreign visitors.
The local people's hospitality made our trip unforgettable.

reading.title: When Culture Meets the Road: China's Holiday Travel Boom
reading.content: During the recent holiday, travel and consumption spending stayed vibrant across China. Millions of people hit the road: some returned to their hometowns, others explored museums, ancient towns and mountain villages. Foreign visitors shared the things about China that blow their minds — high-speed trains, safe streets, late-night food markets and the hospitality of local people. Meanwhile, a small town at the foot of the Jinggang Mountains shows how travel and culture can grow together. Once dependent on coal mining, Tianhe town has completed a green transition, turning beekeeping and eco-tourism into a sweet future for Gen Z workers. Elsewhere, the autumn grain harvest is in full swing, painting the countryside in spectacular colors that attract photographers and families alike. As the flame for the Changchun 2027 Winter Universiade was lit in Turin, the world is once again looking toward China. Travel, after all, is where culture becomes experience.
reading.translation: 在刚刚过去的假期里，中国各地的旅游与消费支出保持旺盛。数百万人踏上旅途：有人回到家乡，有人走进博物馆、古镇与山村。外国游客分享了令他们惊叹的中国元素——高铁、安全的街道、深夜美食集市以及当地人的热情好客。与此同时，井冈山脚下的一座小镇展示了旅游与文化如何共同成长。天河镇曾依赖采煤，如今已完成绿色转型，把养蜂与生态旅游变成了属于Z世代的美好未来。在其他地方，秋粮收获正全面展开，把乡村染成壮美的色彩，吸引着摄影爱好者与家庭游客。随着2027年长春冬季大运会火种在都灵点燃，世界的目光再次投向中国。毕竟，旅行正是文化转化为体验的方式。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily 2026-10-10 报道《Travel, consumption spending vibrant during holiday》《10 things in China that blow foreign visitors' minds》《Gen Z finds a sweet future in hometown's green transition》《Autumn grain harvest in full swing across China》及《Flame lit in Turin for Changchun 2027 Winter Universiade》改写。
